reviews.title: This app is a no brainer.
reviews.text: First of all, I would like to say the Habit Tracker app is an app I would certainly recommend. Before I downloaded this app, I felt extremely pessimistic about what I can do to achieve a strong social life. My relationships with my relatives and my close friends were falling apart, and my mental health was placed on the back burner. But with this app, everything about this is starting to change, I feeling more confident than I had in 10 years to achieving a better future for myself, and the betterment of my well being. I’ve been through countless therapies, and doctors appointments often going out of town to meet those objectives. Because of this, it was an extreme drain on my mental health, not only on myself, but my parents as well, I can’t imagine how much money it costs to doing these kind of things. I say that no parent wants to go through that at all. At 14 years old, I was sent to Copper Hills in Utah for two years, this treatment program in large part did in fact help me get back on the right track, but I started to relapse into another mental breakdown this last October, and I was admitted to the hospital as a result. I felt like that there was no hope in going back when I went through this, and I often contemplated in suicide as a result. Today, I can now see myself as a strong and capable person who can climb back up to where I left off before, and I now feel more optimistic about my bright future than I had in a long time, and with that I can now start to seeing real results, and I have my therapist, including this app to thank for the additional support.

reviews.title: What a beautifully designed and thoughtful app
reviews.text: I came upon this app after wanting something to help me track habits on my phone. I’m a big fan of Atomic Habits (a book that I highly recommend) that is life changing and this app is the perfect tool for something like that. It is so customizable in colors, emojis, themes and that makes it more fun and visually appealing to use. It also has suggested habits to help if you get stuck. I used to write my habits in a planner or paper but found it was hard to keep up because I don’t carry a planner around with me everywhere I go as much as my phone. This app is so much more convenient and because it has everything I need and I come back and use it daily. That makes it for it to be an effective habit tracker and builder. Props to the development team for being so thoughtful on this app. Thank you!! The basic feature allows 5-6 free habits and the premium features allow more. I’ve been using the free plan for a week and I’m in love with it and am considering upgrading. They are also one of the rare few to let you buy lifetime membership for one price which makes me think of the old days when apps first came out. I prefer that so much more than subscription model I would later cancel when I’m on a budget. Highly recommend this app to build better habits and change your life!

reviews.title: I genuinely love it!
reviews.text: It’s an all around good app! It has helped me pray the rosary everyday. I currently have a 313 day streak so I’ve been using the app for about a year now. It has basically become apart of my daily life. I’m up to over 10 habits right now lol. With my ADHD I find it hard to remember what to do. But when I have to look at it every and see what I have and haven’t done it’s really good. It works especially great with another app great for ADHD, Structured. It is a time management app which is great. As much as I love this app and literally it keeps my life kind of together-ish I can’t seem to add any widgets to my Lock Screen. I would TOTALLY give this a five. But I can’t add the widget so it’s a four. And, when I asked them about it some how they didn’t understand what I wad saying. When I go to my Lock Screen so Edit the widget it brings me to the app and literally nothing happens. I tapped Edit widget and it brings me to the app, then I tapped a habit thinking that even though there was NO indication that I was in edit mode it would still add some how. NOPE didn’t work. If just brings me to the habit where I can edit it or look at my streak. It doesn’t add the widget to my Lock Screen. It works perfectly fine for my Home Screen so I don’t know why it doesn’t work for my Lock Screen. I love this app so it was sad. And I’m frustrated. Hopefully they make it so there’s a different interface when in editing mode. 💕

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: The design of this takes a little bit to learn but after that learning period, there’s so much usability for the day to day person. Even underneath the free umbrella, there’s a lot that can be useful. I love the simplicity of this app and it’s quiet aesthetically pleasing for me personally. You can set reminders and memos about habits each day. I’ve been using it for a few days. I’ve tried other apps like Habitica which was another great app. However, I wanted something that was less reward based and more for the sake of tracking/researching my own habits. This app stuck out among the plethora of apps on the store. I am grateful so far to have gotten it. I will probably purchase the lifetime access so I can see the weekly, monthly, and yearly diagrams from my habits. But it’s not necessary if you are just looking for something to help you keep track of your everyday habits (whether they are good or bad ones). I would recommend at least giving it a try for a period of time and seeing if you like it like I do :) Edit: I have a suggestion for the app! They should add an option for “bad habits” that you want to stop doing. I realized I needed yo reword my bad habits in a way that I can cross them off my list. But maybe if they implemented a way for them to be in the system so it doesn’t take away from your completion rate for the day… for example, if I’m trying to quit drinking coffee, I would put “not drink coffee” as my habit. Instead of “coffee” which means the habit wouldn’t be completed and looks like you didn’t finish everything on your list (even tho that’s a good thing.) other than that, the app is great 😃

reviews.title: An amazing habit tracker!
reviews.text: I’ve been using Habit since it was originally free and it has since then helped me keep track of what I needed to do in a day, consistently. The widgets and user interface are are both understandable. You can take a glance at the widgets and it will tell you all the habits that you have and haven't finished yet. I haven’t seen any other habit tracking app give the user this much customizability. You can change icons, descriptions of habits, what time Habit should notify you about a habit, make the habit timed or a count, and even make habits weekly. All of this customization comes with the free version, although I believe it only gives you 3 free habits to keep track of, unlike the premium version which gives users unlimited habits. I consistently workout and do any weekly chores without forgetting because of Habit! Life can be overwhelming sometimes so having an app remind you of what you need to do can be handy. This app does motivate you to do your habits. The streak system, sound effects for completing a habit, and the mini calendar that gets marked with a completed habit, are all subtle celebrations that encourage the user to keep completing habits. Overall, Habit is a very user friendly habit tracking app with many customization options. It will ensure that you’re consistent with your habits!

reviews.title: Best habit tracker for iOS
reviews.text: I used the free version of this app for about a year and it has many great features. I recently paid for the lifetime subscription because I wanted the reports and extra features. The subscriptions are affordable and very much worth it, in my opinion. I love that there are so many different ways to track habits, like daily, or 20 minutes a day, or 4 hours a week. I recently made goals for the year and was able to start tracking every single one I wanted to in the app. My one small feature request would be to allow you to edit the frequency/time of a habit after it has been made. Like, right now, my goal may be to practice piano three times a week for 20 minutes, but if I wanted to change it to four times a week for 30 minutes next month, I would either have to change the habit and reset all my data for it or archive it and make a new one with my new goal. Overall, though, this is an amazing app that is getting regular updates and is very well thought out. I highly recommend it if you are looking to set some goals and build new habits. I set one habit on it daily with an alarm to remind me to track my habit at the end of the day, and I have been doing so successfully for months now.

reviews.title: Love this App!!
reviews.text: I’ve been using the Habit app for a couple of years now, and I absolutely LOVE it! I can’t live without it. The widget on my phone makes it so easy to track my habits at a glance. It’s been a game changer, helping me stay in control of my life and healthy habits. The app clearly shows what I need to improve on and what I’m doing well, and the reward system is a great motivator. However, I have a suggestion for improvement. When I review my performance for each habit, whether I check off the habit or skip it, it shows as completed on the calendar for monthly and yearly review view points. This doesn’t give me a true view of my consistency. It would be great if the review and monthly overview could differentiate between completed and skipped habits. If this feature already exists in the settings, please let me know! Additionally, while I know you can set habits for specific days or every day, a more flexible option would be nice. I’d love the ability to set habits to be done, say, three times a week without specifying the days. A floating check-off option that continues to pop up every day until I complete it would be perfect. Overall, the Habit app is fantastic, but these tweaks would make it even better!

reviews.title: Fantastic app to track habits!!!
reviews.text: Seriously the BEST habit tracker I found. All the other ones are “free” where they limit you to nothing except opening the app before they spam you with upgrading to a $9.99/month subscription. This app has an actual free version that’s very usable, and beyond that a lifetime purchase is only $5.99! Extremely fair and reasonable, and a price I was more than happy to pay for how polished, clean, and useful this app is! The app itself is very clean and modern looking, as well as very easy to use. Lots of customisability, great graphs and insights and gorgeous widgets! My two favourite things are the yearly overview where I can see all my habits on one page and how many days out of the year I’ve completed them, and the second is the widgets so I can easily see which habit I still need to complete and I can easily tap it and mark it complete from my Home Screen. Overall this app feels very polished and clean, works great and has really good detailed stats on you habits that make it a joy to log everyday and keep you motivated. That, along with a non-subscription model and a price of just $5.99 for lifetime access makes it one of my favourite and most used apps!

reviews.title: An effective and motivating habit tracker
reviews.text: I've been using this app for a few months now, and I have to say, it's made a huge difference in my life. The app is incredibly user-friendly, with a simple and clean interface that makes it easy to track my habits and stay on top of my goals. What I love most about this app is the level of customization it offers. I can set up reminders for each habit, choose specific days of the week to focus on certain habits, and even track my progress over time with graphs and charts. The app also has a wide range of pre-set habits to choose from, which is great if you're looking for inspiration or just starting out on your habit-building journey. But perhaps the best feature of this app is the sense of accountability it provides. I love being able to see my progress and check off each habit as I complete it. It's incredibly motivating and has helped me to stay on track with my goals. Overall, I would highly recommend the app to anyone looking to build new habits and achieve their goals. It's an incredibly useful tool for staying organized, motivated, and on track.

reviews.title: Checks all the boxes
reviews.text: This app is the perfect habit tracker for me! It has the ability to repeat daily, weekly and monthly. You can track each goal with specific units (ex. count, minutes, seconds, miles, etc.). You can also put on the timer for for the goals you’re tracking with time units or just manually enter the units. Set multiple reminders. Choose an end date (or no end date) for goals. Choose frequency. You can also set a habit with no specific day but multiple (or once) a week. Great for me because some habits I want to maintain don’t have designated days (yet). You can even set a passcode for the app. Multiple widgets. Looks clean. Clean interface. BIG PLUS: Ability to retrospectively track habits. Some days you may forget to log habits or for me, some of my habits are technically done the next day but I want it to count the previous day (I’m a night owl). Example: one of my habits is to take my nightly vitamins. I usually take them after 11:59pm but I still want it to count for that day. So this was big for me. This app really helps me be consistent with my goals. The streak 🔥 encourages me not to break my streaks, therefore my habits. BIG PLUS: ONE TIME FEE ($5.99) I don’t know why some other habit tracker apps would charge a monthly subscription fee. Ridiculous. SUGGESTIONS TO DEVELOPERS: The hidden habits don’t stay hidden. You have to manually hide them daily which is inconvenient and defeats the purpose. Also maybe tracking items before making it a goal would be nice, so that it doesn’t affect your analytics. For instance, I just want to track my water intake before making it a goal to drink x amount a day. It would also be nice if habits could be broken down by anytime, day, night without clicking just one in “Status”. If I were to click “Now” I may not remember to change it back later but if it had sections on the normal screen, that would be cool and still keep the completed task at the bottom.
